title: Research a Todo's current situation
summary: Create a dated, evidence-backed account of what is true now, who owns each area, what constraints and gaps exist, and whether the todo is ready for desired-state design.
use_when: An open canonical `tN` needs a dated evidence-grounded description of current state before design reconciliation.
Each relevant jurisdiction should identify exactly one owner plus any participants and consumers.
do_not_use_when: The request is to choose desired architecture, revise direction, authorize a decision, or execute work.
The subject is not an established open canonical todo umbrella.
Runtime or tool failure would be misrepresented as a domain evidence gap.
outcome: One immutable dated `aN` bound to exact todo and source bases, with current findings, jurisdictions, direction coverage, unresolved items, and a ready, needs-user-choice, or inconclusive disposition.
effects: Freezes current direction, concerns, note cursor, accepted design, Todo projection, and a catalog of admitted evidence sources.
Submits one constrained Nucleus job with source-specific read/search tools and may consume Codex allowance.
Records one immutable assessment; any newer assessment for the umbrella makes every older one non-current.
authority: Todo owns assessment bases, source references, findings, jurisdictions, disposition, currentness, and domain success.
The liaison can describe current state only; it cannot revise direction, choose design, route concerns, or authorize changes.
success: Todo records a complete `aN` whose material findings cite admitted exact basis references.
Every jurisdiction has concrete responsibilities and exactly one owner.
The disposition truthfully distinguishes adequate evidence, required user choice, and material evidence gaps.
failure_and_recovery: A runtime or missing-tool failure is reported as infrastructure failure rather than an inconclusive domain fact.
If direction, attachments, notes, accepted design, or source bases change, retain the historical assessment but treat it as stale and reassess.
Creating a newer assessment intentionally makes the older assessment non-current.
privacy: Todo retains source locators, frozen revisions, observation times, and evidence references rather than copying ordinary decision-source contents.
Nucleus raw output may retain source content read by the assessment liaison.
does_not_authorize: Revising the todo direction or routing concerns.
Choosing or accepting a desired design.
Implementing any identified gap or responsibility.

consumers.statement: A caller preparing desired-state reconciliation may request one dated, evidence-backed description of an established Todo umbrella's current situation.
The assessment is not a design choice, authorization, implementation instruction, or substitute for an owning system's current truth.

preconditions.statement: The selected tN is open and canonical and Todo can freeze its current direction, attachments, note cursor, accepted design, own projection, and admitted evidence catalog.
Compatible authenticated Nucleus execution and the source-specific tools required by the frozen catalog are available.

inputs.statement: The public input is one exact tN plus optional documented quality or model selection; the host supplies the frozen Todo bases and bounded source catalog.
The caller cannot use this stage to revise direction, choose architecture, introduce unrestricted sources, grant shell or web access, or authorize work.

outputs.statement: The result is one immutable aN containing observation time, exact bases, summary, subject identity, grounded findings, jurisdiction assignments, direction coverage, unresolved items, and ready, needs_user_choice, or inconclusive disposition.
Historical reads expose the persisted source-ref mapping and derived current or stale reasons without editing the assessment.

data_semantics.statement: ready means evidence is adequate for design reconciliation, needs_user_choice means a material authority or value choice cannot be inferred, and inconclusive means a material evidence gap remains.
Each jurisdiction assigns concrete responsibilities to parties as owner, participant, or consumer with exactly one owner; infrastructure failure is not an inconclusive domain finding.

identity_and_units.statement: aN identifies one immutable dated assessment of one tN; stable s-... source IDs map to persisted source:<id> bases and exact evidence locations.
This capability publishes no quantitative accounting or pricing unit.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: A committed assessment covers every boundary in the frozen direction, records every used admitted source and jurisdiction, and distinguishes unresolved choices from evidence gaps.
The observation is dated and basis-bound; any newer assessment or change to its recorded Todo bases makes it non-current without rewriting history.
The bounded catalog is not a global proof that every potentially relevant external source or later state was observed.

access.statement: The current-user Todo CLI starts one constrained Nucleus stage whose only evidence access is list, read, and search over the frozen admitted source catalog.
The stage has no shell, broad workspace, inherited environment, web search, routing decision, design decision, or implementation interface.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Todo freezes the assessment basis before submission and commits the validated aN atomically; replay identities prevent duplicate domain results.
Assessments are append-only observations, and creating a newer aN intentionally makes every older assessment for the umbrella non-current.

operational_limits.statement: One invocation assesses one open canonical umbrella from one bounded catalog in one Nucleus attempt and cannot mutate the subject or external evidence.
No evidence-source count, observation recency threshold, assessment latency, or model-quality service-level objective is promised.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Capability contract version 1 preserves immutable aN identity, exact frozen bases, three dispositions, jurisdiction ownership rules, and versioned Nucleus schemas and toolsets.
No universal source-revision protocol, external freshness window, or deprecation period is promised.

reliances.statement: Assessment generation relies on Nucleus for one constrained model execution, authentication, durable job state, and raw protocol history; Todo remains authoritative for the committed assessment record (aN).
Assessment findings rely on the selected evidence sources for their cited state and authority, but no single installed contract describes the heterogeneous source catalog.
